items.desc_en: A morning earthquake shook Colombian capital Bogota on Monday, with the tremor being felt as far away as the border with Venezuela, witnesses told Reuters.
items.desc_zh: 目击者告诉路透社，哥伦比亚首都波哥大周一早上发生地震，震感远至委内瑞拉边境。

items.title_en: Taylor Farms recalls salsa and guacamole from Walmart, Kroger over salmonella risk
items.title_zh: 泰勒农场因沙门氏菌风险从沃尔玛和克罗格召回莎莎酱和鳄梨酱
items.desc_en: Taylor Farms said on Sunday it was recalling prepared food items containing jalapenos from retailers, including Walmart, Kroger and Whole Foods in some states.
items.desc_zh: 泰勒农场周日表示，正在从一些州的沃尔玛、克罗格和全食超市等零售商处召回含有墨西哥胡椒的预制食品。

items.title_en: World's oceans hit record-high July temperatures
items.title_zh: 七月世界海洋气温创历史新高
items.desc_en: Global oceans recorded their hottest July on record, partly fuelled by developing El Niño conditions, as wildfires continue to ravage western Europe.
items.desc_zh: 全球海洋经历了有记录以来最热的七月，部分原因是厄尔尼诺现象的发展，野火继续肆虐西欧。

items.title_en: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian strike on Russia's Tatarstan region, officials say
items.title_zh: 官员称乌克兰对俄罗斯鞑靼斯坦地区的袭击至少造成13人死亡
items.desc_en: It is one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks on Russia since the start of Moscow's war on Ukraine.
items.desc_zh: 这是自莫斯科对乌克兰战争爆发以来乌克兰对俄罗斯最致命的无人机袭击之一。

items.title_en: Tech leaders say AI means less work - their staff say they work up to 90 hours a week

items.desc_en: Tech companies are not modelling their own claims of the technology giving people more free time.
items.desc_zh: 科技公司并没有模仿自己的说法，声称这项技术可以给人们更多的空闲时间。
